title: HttpRequest
description: HTTP data archetype — HTTP request message classification. Rootless (no GSM base extension). Types the data payload flowing through Effector/Receptor ports when the payload is an HTTP request message. Source: RFC 9110 (HTTP Semantics, 2022), §3.4 — Messages; RFC 9112 (HTTP/1.1, 2022), §3 — Request Line.

method.description: HTTP request method. GET — retrieve a representation of the target resource. HEAD — same as GET but without response body. POST — process a representation subordinate to the target resource. PUT — replace the target resource state entirely. PATCH — partially modify the target resource state. DELETE — remove the target resource. OPTIONS — describe communication options for the target resource. Source: RFC 9110 §9.

targetURI.description: The request target identifying the resource upon which to apply the request. Source: RFC 9110 §7.1 — Determining the Target Resource.

contentType.description: Media type of the request payload body (IANA media type). Source: RFC 9110 §8.3 — Content-Type.
